instruction: Take the image file OIP.jpg located in /home/user and export it to PDF format. Name the output file "receipt_copy.pdf" and place it in the /home/user directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting OIP.jpg to PDF named 'receipt_copy.pdf' in /home/user. Evaluator verifies: (1) file exists at specified path, (2) exactly 1 page, (3) file size > 10KB, (4) contains image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file existence at specified path '/home/user/receipt_copy.pdf'
Metric logically checks PDF page count (eq 1) which is appropriate for single image conversion
Content verification appropriately checks file size > 10KB to ensure non-empty/non-corrupted PDF
Image detection logic correctly traverses XObject resources to verify PDF contains image content from source OIP.jpg
Postconfig includes 2-second sleep to allow filesystem to settle before verification
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements verified (file location, name, PDF format, image content)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Metric verifies presence of ANY image in PDF rather than validating it's specifically the OIP.jpg content, but this is acceptable for format conversion tasks
